  4606	        try drainCancelled.check()
  4607	        try Task.checkCancellation()
  4608	        if shouldCancel() { throw CancellationError() }
  4609	        let streamState = AttachedPagedKVStreamState(request: request)
  4610	        let maxOutputTokens = request.maxTokens ?? max(1, maxContextTokens - prepared.promptTokens.count)
  4611	        let preparedPromptTokenIDs = prepared.promptTokens.map(Int32.init)
  4612	        let batchKVBits = Self.effectiveKVBits(
  4613	            configured: kvBitsOverride,

  4618	            incomingTokens: preparedPromptTokenIDs,

  4623	        if try await serialRouteCanaryCachedHitMissingRetainedHandoff(
  4624	            lease,

  4628	            return nil
  4629	        }
  4630	        let result: ContinuousBatchSchedulerResult
  4631	        do {
  4632	            // The SPEC-019 structured idle timeout ends the row as it ends the
  4633	            // serial generate loop.
  4634	            result = try await Self.withDrainAndClientCancellation(
  4635	                drainCancelled,
  4636	                shouldCancel: { shouldCancel() || idleCancellation.isFired }
  4637	            ) {
  4638	                try await scheduler.submit(ContinuousBatchSchedulerRequest(
  4639	                    id: schedulerRequestID,
  4640	                    conversationKey: request.conversationKey ?? "",
  4641	                    promptTokens: prepared.promptTokens,
  4642	                    maxOutputTokens: maxOutputTokens,

  6881	    private static func longestSuffixPrefixLength(in text: String, candidates: [String]) -> Int {

  6889	            if candidates.contains(where: { $0.hasPrefix(suffix) }) {
  6890	                longest = length
  6891	            }
  6892	        }
  6893	        return longest
  6894	    }

  6988	    private static func harmonyVisibleFinalTokenCount(
  6989	        tokenIDs: [Int],
  6990	        parsedContent: String,
  6991	        visibleText: String,
  6992	        decode: ([Int]) -> String
  6993	    ) -> Int {
  6994	        guard !visibleText.isEmpty, !tokenIDs.isEmpty else { return 0 }
  6995	        guard visibleText != parsedContent else { return tokenIDs.count }
  6996	        for count in 1 ... tokenIDs.count {
  6997	            let prefix = decode(Array(tokenIDs.prefix(count)))
  6998	            if prefix == visibleText || prefix.hasPrefix(visibleText) {
  6999	                return count
  7000	            }
  7001	            if !visibleText.hasPrefix(prefix) {
  7002	                return max(0, count - 1)
  7003	            }
  7004	        }
  7005	        return tokenIDs.count
  7006	    }

  7137	    static func validateStructuredCompletion(_ completion: CompletionResult, request: ChatCompletionRequest) throws -> CompletionResult {

  7142	        case .text:
  7143	            return completion
  7144	        case .jsonObject:
  7145	            _ = try parseStructuredJSONContent(completion.content, requireObjectOrArray: true)
  7146	            return completion
  7147	        case .jsonSchema(let spec):

  7159	                    param: "",
  7160	                    inferenceRan: true,

  7406	            // unchanged, so the rendered schema keeps its keys and array

  7422	                "function": function,
  7423	            ]
  7424	        }

  7426	    }

  7432	    static func toolFunctionNames(from value: MacProviderCore.JSONValue?) -> Set<String>? {
  7433	        guard let value, case .array(let tools) = value, !tools.isEmpty else {
  7434	            return nil
  7435	        }
  7436	        let names = tools.compactMap { tool -> String? in
  7437	            guard case .object(let toolObject) = tool,
  7438	                  case .object(let functionObject)? = toolObject["function"],
  7439	                  case .string(let name)? = functionObject["name"],
  7440	                  !name.isEmpty
  7441	            else {
  7442	                return nil
  7443	            }
  7444	            return name
  7445	        }
  7446	        return names.isEmpty ? nil : Set(names)
  7447	    }

  7449	    /// Converts a JSONValue subtree into the `Any` graph the chat template
  7450	    /// consumes, preserving every key and array position. JSON null becomes a
  7451	    /// native `Jinja.Value.null` (not `NSNull` and not an omission): swift-jinja
  7452	    /// `Value(any:)` matches `case let value as Value` and passes it through,
  7453	    /// so `default:null`, `const:null`, `enum:[null,…]`, and positional array
  7454	    /// nulls survive round-trip with their original schema semantics (#718/#719).
  7455	    ///
  7456	    /// Recursion is bounded by the caller, not here: tool schemas are rejected
  7457	    /// at `validateTools` (ChatCompletionRequest) when they exceed
  7458	    /// `JSONSchemaValidator.maxDepth`, before `JSONValue.parse` builds the tree
  7459	    /// this walk consumes. So every value reaching here is already depth-capped,
  7460	    /// and the converter can stay a faithful shape-preserving pass with no
  7461	    /// silent truncation of over-deep subtrees.
  7462	    private static func jsonAnyForTemplate(_ value: MacProviderCore.JSONValue) -> Any {
  7463	        switch value {
  7464	        case .object(let object):
  7465	            var result: [String: Any] = [:]
  7466	            result.reserveCapacity(object.count)
  7467	            for (key, member) in object {
  7468	                result[key] = jsonAnyForTemplate(member)
  7469	            }
  7470	            return result
  7471	        case .array(let array):
  7472	            return array.map { jsonAnyForTemplate($0) }
  7473	        case .string(let string):
  7474	            return string
  7475	        case .int(let int):
  7476	            return int
  7477	        case .double(let double):
  7478	            return double
  7479	        case .bool(let bool):
  7480	            return bool
  7481	        case .null:
  7482	            return Jinja.Value.null
  7483	        }
  7484	    }

         default:

         }
     }

         ContinuousBatchingPolicy.logSerialRouteIfNeeded(blocked)

     }

     /// The stored checkpoints a hybrid cached turn hands the scheduler: every
     /// one at or below the cached length (they are a prefix of this prompt).
     /// Empty unless the lease resumes a retained hybrid entry.
     nonisolated static func retainedRecurrentCheckpoints(
         for lease: ConversationCacheLease?
     ) -> [RecurrentStateCheckpoint] {
         guard let lease,
               lease.recurrentCheckpoint != nil,
               let reusable = lease.reusableCache,
               reusable.retainedPagedKVSequence != nil
         else { return [] }
         return reusable.recurrentCheckpoints.filter { $0.tokenCount <= lease.cachedPromptTokens }
     }

     static func droppingTrailingModelStop(
         _ generatedTokens: [Int],
         terminalStatus: ContinuousBatchSchedulerTerminalStatus,
         modelStopTokenIDs: Set<Int>
     ) -> [Int] {
         guard terminalStatus == .stop,
               let last = generatedTokens.last,
               modelStopTokenIDs.contains(last) else {
             return generatedTokens
         }
         return Array(generatedTokens.dropLast())
     }
 
     private static func generationStopTokenIDs(for context: ModelContext) -> Set<Int> {
         var stopTokenIDs = context.configuration.eosTokenIds
         let tokenizer = context.tokenizer
         if let eosTokenID = tokenizer.eosTokenId {
             stopTokenIDs.insert(eosTokenID)
         }
         for token in context.configuration.extraEOSTokens {
             if let tokenID = tokenizer.convertTokenToId(token) {
                 stopTokenIDs.insert(tokenID)
             }
         }
         return stopTokenIDs
     }

    78	        _ request: ChatCompletionRequest,
    79	        vocab: Vocab,
    80	        ids: [Int],
    81	        serialStopTokenCount: Int?,
    82	        status: ContinuousBatchSchedulerTerminalStatus = .stop
    83	    ) throws -> ModelRuntime.ContinuousBatchFinalizedRow {

    85	            request: request,
    86	            result: schedulerResult(ids, status: status),
    87	            modelStopTokenIDs: [],

    97	    /// The serial non-streaming path: its generate callback stops a serial
    98	    /// tool turn at the first complete valid tool call, then it parses and
    99	    /// validates the text of the tokens it generated.
   100	    private func serialComplete(
   101	        _ request: ChatCompletionRequest,
   102	        vocab: Vocab
   103	    ) throws -> (completion: CompletionResult, tokenCount: Int) {
   104	        var generated: [Int] = []
   105	        var observer = NativeToolCallStreamEmitter(
   106	            modelID: request.model,
   107	            allowedFunctionNames: ModelRuntime.toolFunctionNames(from: request.promptSource.tools)
   108	        )
   109	        for id in vocab.ids {
   110	            generated.append(id)
   111	            if ModelRuntime.serialToolStopApplies(request),
   112	               ModelRuntime.observeSerialToolStop(
   113	                   &observer,
   114	                   decoded: vocab.decode(generated),
   115	                   stopTokenFilter: Self.stopTokenFilter,
   116	                   requestStops: request.stop
   117	               ) {
   118	                break
   119	            }
   120	        }
   121	        let filtered = ModelRuntime.applyOutputFilters(
   122	            vocab.decode(generated),
   123	            stopTokenFilter: Self.stopTokenFilter,
   124	            requestStops: request.stop
   125	        )
   126	        let parsed = try ModelRuntime.parseGeneratedOutput(
   127	            filteredText: filtered.text,
   128	            generatedTokenIDs: generated,
   129	            decode: vocab.decode,
   130	            request: request,
   131	            mode: .complete(finishReason: filtered.hitStop ? "request_stop" : "stop"),
   132	            defaultCompletionTokens: generated.count,
   133	            stopTokenFilter: Self.stopTokenFilter,
   134	            requestStops: request.stop,
   135	            globalHitStop: filtered.hitStop
   136	        )
   137	        let completion = try ModelRuntime.validateStructuredCompletion(CompletionResult(
   138	            content: parsed.content,
   139	            finishReason: parsed.toolCalls.isEmpty ? "stop" : "tool_calls",
   140	            promptTokens: 3,
   141	            completionTokens: parsed.completionTokens,
   142	            toolCalls: parsed.toolCalls.isEmpty ? nil : parsed.toolCalls,
   143	            settlementDisposition: .eligibleOwner
   144	        ), request: request)
   145	        return (completion, generated.count)
   146	    }
   147	
   148	    /// The serial streaming path over the same tokens: one emitter step per
   149	    /// token until it would stop generating, then its finish and the
   150	    /// structured verdict on buyer-visible content.
   151	    private func serialStream(
   152	        _ request: ChatCompletionRequest,
   153	        vocab: Vocab
   154	    ) -> (chunks: [String], result: Result<CompletionResult, APIError>) {
   155	        let accumulator = StructuredStreamingContentAccumulator(
   156	            enabled: ModelRuntime.requiresStructuredValidation(request.responseFormat)
   157	        )
   158	        let idle = StructuredStreamingIdleState(enabled: false)
   159	        let sink = ChunkSink()
   160	        var emitter = SerialStreamingTextEmitter(request: request)
   161	        var generated: [Int] = []
   162	        loop: for id in vocab.ids {
   163	            generated.append(id)
   164	            let candidate = ModelRuntime.streamingSafePrefix(
   165	                vocab.decode(generated),
   166	                stopTokenFilter: Self.stopTokenFilter,
   167	                requestStops: request.stop
   168	            )
   169	            switch emitter.step(
   170	                candidate: candidate,
   171	                structuredAccumulator: accumulator,
   172	                idleState: idle,
   173	                onChunk: sink.append
   174	            ) {
   175	            case .more:
   176	                continue
   177	            case .requestStop, .toolCallComplete, .structuredError:
   178	                break loop
   179	            }
   180	        }
   181	        let final = ModelRuntime.applyOutputFilters(
   182	            vocab.decode(generated),
   183	            stopTokenFilter: Self.stopTokenFilter,
   184	            requestStops: request.stop
   185	        )
   186	        do {
   187	            let parsed = try ModelRuntime.parseGeneratedOutput(
   188	                filteredText: final.text,
   189	                generatedTokenIDs: generated,
   190	                decode: vocab.decode,
   191	                request: request,
   192	                mode: .complete(finishReason: "stop"),
   193	                defaultCompletionTokens: generated.count,
   194	                stopTokenFilter: Self.stopTokenFilter,
   195	                requestStops: request.stop,
   196	                globalHitStop: final.hitStop
   197	            )
   198	            try emitter.finish(
   199	                finalText: final.text,
   200	                parsed: parsed,
   201	                structuredAccumulator: accumulator,
   202	                idleState: idle,
   203	                onChunk: sink.append
   204	            )
   205	            let completion = try ModelRuntime.validateStructuredStreamingCompletion(
   206	                CompletionResult(
   207	                    content: parsed.content,
   208	                    finishReason: parsed.toolCalls.isEmpty ? "stop" : "tool_calls",
   209	                    promptTokens: 3,
   210	                    completionTokens: parsed.completionTokens,
   211	                    toolCalls: parsed.toolCalls.isEmpty ? nil : parsed.toolCalls,
   212	                    settlementDisposition: .eligibleOwner
   213	                ),
   214	                request: request,
   215	                buyerVisibleContent: accumulator.content
   216	            )
   217	            return (sink.normalized(), .success(completion))
   218	        } catch {
   219	            return (sink.normalized(), .failure(error as! APIError))
   220	        }
   221	    }
   222	
   223	    /// The batched stream: every delivered token goes through the row's
   224	    /// stream state (tokens past the serial stop point included, as a row
   225	    /// may decode on before `stopEarly` lands), then the batched finalize.
   226	    private func batchedStream(
   227	        _ request: ChatCompletionRequest,
   228	        vocab: Vocab,
   229	        deliveredIDs: [Int]? = nil
   230	    ) -> (chunks: [String], result: Result<CompletionResult, APIError>, stopRequests: Int, finalized: ModelRuntime.ContinuousBatchFinalizedRow?) {
   231	        let accumulator = StructuredStreamingContentAccumulator(
   232	            enabled: ModelRuntime.requiresStructuredValidation(request.responseFormat)
   233	        )
   234	        let idle = StructuredStreamingIdleState(enabled: false)
   235	        let sink = ChunkSink()
   236	        let state = ModelRuntime.AttachedPagedKVStreamState(request: request)
   237	        let ids = deliveredIDs ?? vocab.ids
   238	        var stopRequests = 0
   239	        for id in ids where state.step(
   240	            eventTokens: [id],
   241	            decode: vocab.decode,
   242	            stopTokenFilter: Self.stopTokenFilter,
   243	            requestStops: request.stop,
   244	            structuredAccumulator: accumulator,
   245	            idleState: idle,
   246	            onChunk: sink.append
   247	        ) {
   248	            stopRequests += 1
   249	        }
   250	        if let error = state.error() {
   251	            return (sink.normalized(), .failure(error), stopRequests, nil)
   252	        }
   253	        do {
   254	            let finalized = try finalizeBatched(
   255	                request,
   256	                vocab: vocab,
   257	                ids: ids,
   258	                serialStopTokenCount: state.serialStopTokenCount
   259	            )
   260	            let completion = try ModelRuntime.finishContinuousBatchStream(
   261	                finalized,
   262	                state: state,
   263	                request: request,
   264	                structuredAccumulator: accumulator,
   265	                idleState: idle,
   266	                onChunk: sink.append
   267	            )
   268	            return (sink.normalized(), .success(completion), stopRequests, finalized)
   269	        } catch {
   270	            return (sink.normalized(), .failure(error as! APIError), stopRequests, nil)
   271	        }
   272	    }
   273	
   274	    private func calls(_ toolCalls: [macprovider_cli.ToolCall]?) -> [String] {
   275	        (toolCalls ?? []).map { "\($0.functionName) \($0.arguments)" }
   276	    }

   280	    func testSerialToolTurnTruncatesToSerialStopAndMatchesSerialToolCalls() throws {
   281	        let request = try request(["tools": Self.weatherTool])
   282	        let vocab = Vocab(pieces: Self.twoCallPieces)
   283	        let serial = try serialComplete(request, vocab: vocab)
   284	        XCTAssertLessThan(serial.tokenCount, vocab.pieces.count, "serial stops at the first complete call")
   285	
   286	        // The batched row's sink runs the serial stop test on each token.
   287	        let stop = ModelRuntime.ContinuousBatchSerialToolStopState(request: request)
   288	        var stopRequests = 0
   289	        for id in vocab.ids where stop.observe(
   290	            eventTokens: [id],
   291	            decode: vocab.decode,
   292	            stopTokenFilter: Self.stopTokenFilter,
   293	            requestStops: request.stop
   294	        ) {
   295	            stopRequests += 1
   296	        }
   297	        XCTAssertEqual(stopRequests, 1)
   298	        XCTAssertEqual(stop.stopTokenCount, serial.tokenCount)
   299	
   300	        // The row decoded every token before stopping; the finalize truncates.
   301	        let batched = try finalizeBatched(
   302	            request,
   303	            vocab: vocab,
   304	            ids: vocab.ids,
   305	            serialStopTokenCount: stop.stopTokenCount,
   306	            status: .length
   307	        )
   308	        let completion = try ModelRuntime.validateStructuredCompletion(batched.completion, request: request)
   309	        XCTAssertEqual(calls(completion.toolCalls), calls(serial.completion.toolCalls))
   310	        XCTAssertEqual(calls(completion.toolCalls), [#"get_weather {"city":"Paris"}"#])
   311	        XCTAssertEqual(completion.finishReason, "tool_calls")
   312	        XCTAssertEqual(completion.content, serial.completion.content)
   313	        XCTAssertEqual(completion.completionTokens, serial.completion.completionTokens)
   314	        XCTAssertEqual(completion.completionTokens, serial.tokenCount)
   315	        XCTAssertEqual(batched.generatedTokens, Array(vocab.ids.prefix(serial.tokenCount)))
   316	        XCTAssertTrue(batched.truncatedAtSerialStop, "a row past the stop point must not commit its cache")
   317	    }

   460	    private static func apiCode(_ body: () throws -> Void) -> String? {
   461	        do {
   462	            try body()
   463	            return nil
   464	        } catch let error as APIError {
   465	            return error.code
   466	        } catch {
   467	            return "non_api_error:\(error)"
   468	        }
   469	    }

   471	
   472	/// Normalized SSE-relevant chunks: tool-call ids are random per emitter, so
   473	/// the first delta records only its function name.
   474	private final class ChunkSink: @unchecked Sendable {
   475	    private let lock = NSLock()
   476	    private var chunks: [StreamChunk] = []
   477	
   478	    func append(_ chunk: StreamChunk) {
   479	        lock.lock()
   480	        chunks.append(chunk)
   481	        lock.unlock()
   482	    }
   483	
   484	    func normalized() -> [String] {
   485	        lock.lock()
   486	        defer { lock.unlock() }
   487	        return chunks.map { chunk in
   488	            switch chunk {
   489	            case .content(let text):
   490	                return "content:\(text)"
   491	            case .toolCallDelta(let delta):
   492	                if let name = delta.functionName {
   493	                    return "tool:\(name):\(delta.arguments ?? "")"
   494	                }
   495	                return "args:\(delta.index):\(delta.arguments ?? "")"
   496	            }
   497	        }
   498	    }
   499	}

  1253	    func testRequestStateRepresentableGateOnParsedRequests() throws {
  1254	        // SPEC-038 AC-6b: sampled rows batch with the serial path's sampler and a
  1255	        // row-local seed, so plain sampling parameters no longer force serial.
  1256	        XCTAssertTrue(ModelRuntime.requestStateRepresentable(try parsedRequest([:])))
  1257	
  1258	        let greedy: [String: Any] = ["temperature": 0, "top_p": 1.0]
  1259	        XCTAssertTrue(ModelRuntime.requestStateRepresentable(try parsedRequest(greedy)))
  1260	        XCTAssertTrue(ModelRuntime.requestStateRepresentable(try parsedRequest([
  1261	            "temperature": 0.7, "top_p": 0.9
  1262	        ])))
  1263	        // The serial path ignores presence/frequency penalties, so they do not
  1264	        // change what a batched row must represent.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Regenerate the canonical spec index table in specs/README.md.

The hand-maintained index drifts (it listed SPEC-001..013 while 24 canonical
specs exist). The spec *headers* do not drift — so we derive the index from
them. A file in specs/ is a CANONICAL spec iff:

  1. its first line is a title:   `# SPEC-<NNN> <sep> <Title>`   (sep = — – : -)
  2. it carries a version header:  `**Version:** ...`  in the first 15 lines

Everything else in specs/ (round-N audits, FIX/ABSORB prompts, impl notes,
step docs) is a *supporting* artifact and is intentionally excluded.

Usage:
  python3 scripts/gen_spec_index.py           # rewrite the index in place
  python3 scripts/gen_spec_index.py --check    # exit 1 if the index is stale (CI)

The table is written between these markers in specs/README.md, leaving all
human-authored prose intact:

  <!-- AUTOGEN:spec-index START ... -->
  <!-- AUTOGEN:spec-index END -->
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import glob, json, os, re, sys

SPECS_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "specs")
README = os.path.join(SPECS_DIR, "README.md")
CONFORMANCE = os.path.join(SPECS_DIR, "CONFORMANCE.json")
BEGIN = "<!-- AUTOGEN:spec-index START"
END = "<!-- AUTOGEN:spec-index END -->"

TITLE_RE = re.compile(r"^#\s+SPEC[-\s]0*(\d+)\s*[—–:\-]\s*(.+?)\s*$", re.I)
# Version header is written `**Version:** 1.6 (...)` — the colon sits inside the
# bold markers, so strip all `*` before matching rather than trying to anchor them.
VER_RE = re.compile(r"^Version\s*:\s*(\S+)", re.I)
# some specs (025+) carry the version in a `Status: DRAFT v0.13 · …` line instead
STATUS_RE = re.compile(r"^Status\b.*?\b(v?\d+\.\d+(?:\.\d+)?)", re.I)
FNAME_RE = re.compile(r"^SPEC-0*(\d+)-", re.I)


def parse_spec(path: str):
    """Return (num, title, version) if path is a canonical spec, else None.

    num comes from the FILENAME (authoritative); a title/filename number
    mismatch is reported as a warning rather than silently trusted.
    """
    base = os.path.basename(path)
    try:
        head = open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read(3000).splitlines()
    except OSError:
        return None
    if not head:
        return None
    tm = TITLE_RE.match(head[0].strip())
    if not tm:
        return None
    version = None
    for line in head[:15]:
        clean = line.replace("*", "").strip()
        vm = VER_RE.match(clean)
        if vm:
            version = vm.group(1).rstrip(".,;")
            break
        # second convention (SPEC-025+): `Status: DRAFT v0.13 · Owner: …`
        sm = STATUS_RE.match(clean)
        if sm:
            version = sm.group(1)
            break
    if version is None:
        return None
    fm = FNAME_RE.match(base)
    num = int(fm.group(1)) if fm else int(tm.group(1))
    title_num = int(tm.group(1))
    if fm and title_num != num:
        print(f"WARN {base}: filename says SPEC-{num:03d} but title says "
              f"SPEC-{title_num:03d}", file=sys.stderr)
    return num, tm.group(2).strip(), version


def collect():
    specs, seen = [], {}
    for path in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(SPECS_DIR, "*.md"))):
        parsed = parse_spec(path)
        if not parsed:
            continue
        num, title, version = parsed
        rel = os.path.basename(path)
        if num in seen:
            print(f"WARN duplicate canonical SPEC-{num:03d}: "
                  f"{seen[num]} and {rel}", file=sys.stderr)
        seen[num] = rel
        specs.append((num, title, version, rel))
    specs.sort(key=lambda s: (s[0], s[3]))
    # gap report — canonical numbers missing in the 1..max range
    nums = {s[0] for s in specs}
    if nums:
        gaps = [n for n in range(1, max(nums) + 1) if n not in nums]
        if gaps:
            print("NOTE no canonical spec doc for SPEC numbers: "
                  + ", ".join(f"{n:03d}" for n in gaps), file=sys.stderr)
    return specs


def load_governance():
    try:
        with open(CONFORMANCE, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            manifest = json.load(handle)
    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        sys.exit(f"error: cannot read {CONFORMANCE}: {exc}")
    if not isinstance(manifest, dict):
        sys.exit(f"error: {CONFORMANCE} root must be an object")
    spec_records = manifest.get("specs")
    requirement_records = manifest.get("requirements")
    if not isinstance(spec_records, list) or not isinstance(requirement_records, list):
        sys.exit(f"error: {CONFORMANCE} specs and requirements must be arrays")
    metadata = {}
    for index, record in enumerate(spec_records):
        if not isinstance(record, dict) or not isinstance(record.get("spec_id"), str):
            sys.exit(f"error: {CONFORMANCE} specs[{index}] must be an object with spec_id")
        metadata[record["spec_id"]] = record
    states = {}
    for index, requirement in enumerate(requirement_records):
        if not isinstance(requirement, dict) or not isinstance(requirement.get("spec_id"), str) or not isinstance(requirement.get("state"), str):
            sys.exit(f"error: {CONFORMANCE} requirements[{index}] must contain string spec_id and state")
        states.setdefault(requirement["spec_id"], {}).setdefault(requirement["state"], 0)
        states[requirement["spec_id"]][requirement["state"]] += 1
    return metadata, states


def render(specs, metadata, states) -> str:
    rows = [
        "| SPEC | Title | Version | Lifecycle | ID migration | Conformance | Link |",
        "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|",
    ]
    for num, title, version, rel in specs:
        spec_id = f"SPEC-{num:03d}"
        record = metadata.get(spec_id, {})
        requirement_states = states.get(spec_id, {})
        summary = ", ".join(f"{name}: {count}" for name, count in sorted(requirement_states.items()))
        if not summary:
            summary = "pending corpus migration"
        rows.append(
            f"| {spec_id} | {title} | {version} | {record.get('status', 'untracked')} | "
            f"{record.get('requirement_id_migration', 'untracked')} | {summary} | [{rel}]({rel}) |"
        )
    return "\n".join(rows)


def splice(readme_text: str, table: str) -> str:
    if BEGIN not in readme_text or END not in readme_text:
        sys.exit(f"error: markers not found in {README}. Add:\n"
                 f"  {BEGIN} -->\n  {END}\naround the index table.")
    pre = readme_text.split(BEGIN, 1)[0]
    post = readme_text.split(END, 1)[1]
    marker_line = (f"{BEGIN} — regenerated by scripts/gen_spec_index.py; "
                   f"do not edit between markers -->")
    return f"{pre}{marker_line}\n{table}\n{END}{post}"


def lint_root() -> int:
    """Fail if any TRACKED specs/*.md is neither a canonical spec nor an allowed
    meta file — keeps specs/ root canonical-only so the reorg doesn't erode.
    Uses `git ls-files` (not glob) so local untracked scratch is ignored."""
    import subprocess
    repo = os.path.abspath(os.path.dirname(SPECS_DIR))
    keep = {"README.md", "REORG_PLAN.md", "TEMPLATE.md", "PROCESS.md"}
    all_tracked = subprocess.run(["git", "ls-files", "specs/*.md"],
                                 capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=repo).stdout.split()
    # only specs/ ROOT — subdirs (specs/design/**, specs/v0_3-design/**) are
    # intentionally non-canonical design records, not clutter.
    tracked = [rel for rel in all_tracked if rel.count("/") == 1]
    bad = [rel for rel in tracked
           if os.path.basename(rel) not in keep
           and parse_spec(os.path.join(repo, rel)) is None]
    if bad:
        print("error: non-canonical files tracked in specs/ root — relocate them "
              "(audits/ or docs/) or give them a canonical spec header:",
              file=sys.stderr)
        for rel in bad:
name: spec-index

permissions:
  contents: read

# Fails a PR when specs/README.md no longer matches the canonical spec headers.
# The index is generated by scripts/gen_spec_index.py; run it locally and commit
# when you add/rename a spec or bump a `**Version:**` header.

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "specs/**"
      - "schemas/spec-authority-v1.schema.json"
      - "schemas/spec-conformance-v1.schema.json"
      - "schemas/spec-pr-governance-v1.schema.json"
      - "scripts/check_spec_governance.py"
      - "scripts/check_spec_pr_declaration.py"
      - "scripts/gen_spec_index.py"
      - "scripts/tests/**"

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Validate authority and conformance against the real corpus
        run: python3 scripts/check_spec_governance.py --base-ref "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}"
      - name: Verify specs/README.md index is up to date
        run: python3 scripts/gen_spec_index.py --check
      - name: Verify specs/ root is canonical-only (no re-accumulated clutter)
        run: python3 scripts/gen_spec_index.py --lint
      - name: Prove governance validator rejects seeded drift
        run: python3 -m unittest -v scripts.tests.test_spec_governance scripts.tests.test_spec_pr_declaration scripts.tests.test_byom_contract_lock scripts.tests.test_buyer_paid_path_journey_result scripts.tests.test_local_consumer_endpoint_evidence_capture scripts.tests.test_local_consumer_endpoint_journey_result
      - name: Require explicit behavior-change declaration
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: python3 scripts/check_spec_pr_declaration.py --event "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH" --base "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}" --head "${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}"
